term: moves only as moved in the relevant respect (weak reading of the per se link)
definition: A mover that is moved in a respect bearing on its moving is a per se link (the hand's being moved bears on the stick's moving the stone; a man's digesting does not). The premise is one-directional: it does not say that only such movers are per se links. Reading B of the same sentence; it yields only a mover unmoved as mover of its series.
